original_question: Let A be an Artin local ring over an algebraically closed field k of characteristic 0, and let M be a finitely generated A-module. If D(M) denotes the A-module of k-derivations from A to M and s(M) denotes the socle of M, is l(D(M)) always at least l(M) - l(s(M)), and does equality hold exactly when A is isomorphic to k[x]/x^n and M is free?
